title: Didymin alleviates neuropathic pain by targeting RKIP-mediated NF-kappaB/NLRP3 crosstalk to inhibit pyroptosis and neuroinflammation.
authors: Wang, Ke; Guo, Anhao; Chen, Yige; Xia, Chuanpeng; Liang, Jinghao; Zhang, Xiuzhi; Huang, Longze; Zhang, Zhe; Wu, Long; Yan, Hede
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Didymin通过RKIP介导NF-kappaB/NLRP3通路缓解神经病理性疼痛，虽含分子对接但核心为小分子-蛋白互作及神经炎症机制，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Mentha haplocalyx Briq. (Mentha) is recorded in the Pharmacopoeia of the People's Republic of China. It has the effect of relieving pain. Its main active component, Didymin, exhibits a variety of pharmacological activities, yet its mechanism of action in neuropathic pain remains not fully clarified. AIM OF THE STUDY: This study focuses on elucidating the analgesic efficacy of Didymin and delineating its underlying molecular pathways. METHODS: Network pharmacology and molecular docking were used to identify potential targets of Didymin in neuropathic pain. The analgesic effects were assessed in rats with chronic constriction injury (CCI) following Didymin treatment. Transcriptomic profiling (RNA-seq), in vitro microglial experiments, and pharmacological inhibition using Locostatin (an RKIP inhibitor) were performed to elucidate mechanistic pathways. RESULTS: Didymin significantly alleviated mechanical allodynia in CCI rats and upregulated mitophagy-related proteins (LC3, TOM20). It decreased NLRP3, ASC, GSDMD, and phosphorylated NF-kappaB levels, while enhancing RKIP expression. Molecular docking and dynamics confirmed stable binding between Didymin and RKIP. The protective effects were abolished by Locostatin, confirming RKIP dependence. CONCLUSION: Didymin ameliorates neuropathic pain by promoting RKIP expression and suppressing NF-kappaB/NLRP3-mediated pyroptosis and neuroinflammation. These findings bridge traditional Chinese medicine with molecular neuroscience, supporting Didymin as a promising candidate for pain management.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：薄荷（Mentha haplocalyx Briq.）被收录于《中华人民共和国药典》。其具有止痛功效。其主要活性成分地达明（Didymin）表现出多种药理活性，但其在神经病理性疼痛中的作用机制尚未完全阐明。研究目的：本研究旨在阐明地达明的镇痛效果，并描绘其潜在的分子通路。方法：采用网络药理学和分子对接技术，鉴定地达明在神经病理性疼痛中的潜在靶点。在慢性压迫性损伤（CCI）大鼠中，评估地达明治疗后的镇痛效果。通过转录组学分析（RNA-seq）、体外小胶质细胞实验以及使用Locostatin（一种RKIP抑制剂）进行药理学抑制，以阐明机制通路。结果：地达明显著缓解了CCI大鼠的机械性异常性疼痛，并上调了线粒体自噬相关蛋白（LC3、TOM20）的表达。它降低了NLRP3、ASC、GSDMD及磷酸化NF-kappaB的水平，同时增强了RKIP的表达。分子对接和动力学分析确认了地达明与RKIP之间的稳定结合。Locostatin可消除其保护作用，证实了其对RKIP的依赖性。结论：地达明通过促进RKIP表达并抑制NF-kappaB/NLRP3介导的焦亡和神经炎症，从而改善神经病理性疼痛。这些发现将传统中医药与分子神经科学联系起来，支持地达明作为疼痛管理的潜在候选药物。
